questions.title: Who will lead the 2026 Open Championship after the second round?
questions.background: The Open Championship is one of the four major championships in men's professional golf. The halfway leader is the golfer with the lowest cumulative score over the first two rounds.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The R&A's official second-round leaderboard for the 2026 Open Championship, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the golfer occupying outright first place when the second-round standings are finalized, including any applicable scoring penalties. Accepted Answer Format : The golfer's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-11 Genesis Scottish Open Round 3 (CBS Sports, BBC Sport, Golfmagic; suspended due to thick coastal fog): (1) Co-leader Rory McIlroy stumbled +3 through 8 holes (three-putt bogey on 3, chunked gap wedge on 5, missed <1-foot putt on 7) to drop from T1 to T25 (-6, 5 shots back; Scottish Open odds drifted from +220 to 25-1) and now faces an exhausting 28-hole Sunday marathon right before Open week. Reversing yesterday's overreaction to two Renaissance Club rounds restores World No. 1 and defending Open champion Scottie Scheffler—now getting extra Royal Birkdale practice days after missing the Scottish Open cut—slightly ahead (0.065 -> 0.070 vs McIlroy 0.075 -> 0.068). (2) Major new addition: Englishman Matt Fitzpatrick (World No. 4, 3 PGA Tour wins already in 2026, PGA Tour POY frontrunner, Tour-best 28 straight made cuts) fired -3 through 8 holes in nasty coastal fog to seize T1 (-11, 13/5 Scottish Open favorite), entering #3 at 0.042 ahead of Southport native Tommy Fleetwood (held at 0.038 after finishing R3 solidly at -7, T16) and Jon Rahm (0.032 -> 0.030, finished R3 at -4), replacing Xander Schauffele. Top-5 sum 0.248 preserves 75.2% on the remaining 151-player field ahead of Royal Birkdale's R1/R2 AM-PM Irish Sea weather-wave draw.

local_articles.title: ‘Improved’ Royal Birkdale ready to test the world’s best at The Open
local_articles.snippet: Even natural masterpieces can benefit from some brush strokes. In the case of Royal Birkdale, the links on England’s western seaboard that hosts the 154th Open Championship, has involved a number of changes since Jordan Spieth lifted the Claret Jug back in 2017. The go-to course renovators for the R&A in recent times are the architectural team of Mackenzie & Ebert – fronted by Tom Mackenzie and Martin Ebert – and every single hole has had some work conducted in a project which commenced in May 2024, with two totally new holes added to the layout. The most notable changes for the 11th staging of golf’s oldest Major championship at Birkdale involved the complete redesign of the par 4 fifth hole, while the old 14th has gone (converted to a practice area) so that old 15th – lengthened to a par 5 of 602 yards – has moved to become the 14th. questions.title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
questions.background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026. Resolution Date : The date the appointment is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Syria's Ba'athist National Security Bureau was dissolved after Bashar al-Assad's fall, and President Ahmed al-Sharaa established a National Security Council in March 2025 alongside a restructured General Intelligence Service (initially led by Anas Khattab, who became Interior Minister in spring 2025, and since May 2025 by Hussein al-Salama). If Damascus establishes or revives a National Security Bureau in July 2026 to coordinate security agencies, sitting General Intelligence chief Hussein al-Salama and Interior Minister/former spy chief Anas Khattab (al-Sharaa's top security architect) are the leading internal candidates, followed by Defense Minister Murhaf Abu Qasra, Chief of General Staff Ali Noureddine al-Naasan, and senior presidential/interior insider Ali Keda. Given Damascus's history of elevating lesser-known former HTS security commanders whose full names emerge only upon SANA announcement, a full 50% tail mass is left outside these five figures.

local_articles.title: July Start for Commercial Logistics Hub at Syrian Port, Officials Say
local_articles.snippet: Russia hopes by mid-July to have a commercial logistics hub up and running in one of two berths at the naval base it leases in the Syrian port of Tartus, while keeping a military presence at the other, Syrian officials told Reuters. The hub will handle a wide range of Russian goods including wheat and grains, and target initial cargo volumes of around 250,000 metric tons per month, one of the officials said. The project, the officials said, is central to Russian efforts to maintain and expand its influence in Syria through economic channels, after the overthrow of former President Bashar al-Assad in 2024 deprived Moscow of its staunchest ally in the Middle East. But much more than business is at stake, with a battle for influence under way as Washington seeks ways to ensure not only that Syria awards contracts to U.S. companies but also curbs Moscow's military presence. questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Typhoon Noul (12th named storm of 2026) is still weeks from genesis as of June 24, 2026, targeting mid-to-late July. Compared with early July, the subtropical high shifts further north in late July, and 2026's intensifying El Nino plus CMA's April 2026 warning of northward-moving midsummer typhoons tilt probabilities further toward East China (Zhejiang and Fujian) alongside climatological leader Guangdong. Hainan and Guangxi retain meaningful South China Sea probabilities, while 8% is left for Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Liaoning.

questions.title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
questions.background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera. Resolution Condition : Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent. Accepted Answer Format : The successor's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Following Zelenskyy's Jan 2026 reshuffle (making Kyrylo Budanov Head of the Presidential Office and Mykhailo Fedorov Defense Minister), Zelenskyy stated he would next turn to resetting the Armed Forces, and June 12 LIGA.net reporting cited a Syrskyi–Fedorov rift over military transformation. Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi (Joint Forces Commander, former Ground Forces Commander) is Ukraine's leading reform-minded battlefield general, closely followed by Chief of the General Staff Andrii Hnatov (the current #2 officer publicly leading June 2026 reform messaging). Pavlo Palisa (Deputy Head of the Presidential Office for military affairs), Ground Forces Commander Hennadii Shapovalov, and Deputy Defense Minister / former Deputy C-in-C Yevhen Moisiuk round out the top five, with 19% reserved for other senior officers.

questions.title: Who will be appointed Peru's foreign minister in the incoming presidential administration's first cabinet in July 2026?
questions.background: A new presidential administration is scheduled to take office in Peru in July 2026. Its foreign minister will oversee the country's diplomatic relations.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Peruvian government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the person officially appointed minister of foreign affairs in the incoming administration's first cabinet, with the appointment announced by July 31, 2026. Speculation about potential appointments does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed foreign minister's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Keiko Fujimori holds an insurmountable ~43,000-vote lead in Peru's runoff and announced on June 24 that her first cabinet will be broad, plural, and experienced, while keeping nominees strictly confidential (no Foreign Minister leaked yet). Peru's Foreign Ministry (Torre Tagle) overwhelmingly draws from senior career diplomats or conservative former ministers: Hugo de Zela (career diplomat and former FM who resigned in April 2026 over Balcázar's F-16 deal) and incumbent FM Carlos Pareja (a career diplomat considered close to Fujimorismo whom Keiko defended on June 22, though retaining him carries overseas-vote controversy) lead slightly ahead of former FMs Javier González-Olaechea and Elmer Schialer and US Ambassador/ex-minister Alfredo Ferrero. Because Peru has a deep bench of ~25+ viable career ambassadors and no leaks yet, 61% probability mass is appropriately kept outside the top five.

questions.title: What type of munition will be confirmed destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-weapons destruction operation since 2014?
questions.background: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) verifies the destruction of chemical weapons and associated munitions.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the type of munition identified as destroyed in Syria's first OPCW-verified chemical-munitions destruction operation since 2014, as reported to the UN Security Council by 2026-09-03. Resolution Date : 2026-09-03 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the specific munition type, excluding its quantity.
questions.current_reasoning: On May 27, 2026, the OPCW Technical Secretariat announced a major deployment to Syria's Hama-Homs-Latakia triangle that uncovered dozens of previously undeclared Assad-era chemical munitions, specifically highlighting two types: aerial bombs (of the type used in the 2017 Ltamenah and Khan Shaykhun attacks) and rockets (of the type used in the 2013 Ghouta attack). Both OPCW Director-General Fernando Arias and UN Disarmament chief Izumi Nakamitsu (at the June 4 UNSC briefing) stated these newly found munitions must next be formally declared and destroyed under OPCW verification. Aerial bombs (named first in OPCW's report) and rockets (spotlighted at the UNSC) capture 70% combined probability, with smaller allocations to artillery shells, chlorine cylinders, mortar shells, and 12% tail mass for other specific munition designations or newly inspected sites.
